text:
maria.s: Quick follow-up from the PM: incident on 2026-03-18 (cache thrash) — I pulled together proposed remediation items below. Need explicit owners, RACI, Jira links, and handoff plan. Please reply with R/A/C/I and a target date by EOD Friday. TL;DR: recurring KV cache invalidations + aggressive TTLs causing bursty backend rebuilds.

aj: I'll start. For clarity can we split infra-level guardrails vs app-level defenses?

kate: Agreed. I'll take the app-level changes (INF-4523). Proposed R: kate, A: aj, C: devx, I: oncall. Target: 2026-04-01. Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-4523

sanjay: I'll own infra guardrails (INF-4524). R: sanjay, A: aj, C: eng-sre, I: product. Timeline: 2 weeks (2026-03-31). Will add automated alerts for eviction spikes.

jamie: Noted recurring pattern across March incidents — three times we saw P99 latency spike after mass cache invalidation. Action: setup weekly regression to catch TTL regressions. R: jamie, A: maria.s, Target: 2026-04-08.

ops-bot: Deploy-bot: created ticket INF-4525 for rollout checklist and runbook updates. https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-4525

maria.s: Thanks — a couple of logistics: 1) @aj please coordinate handoff from infra->platform for the eviction-rate limiter; 2) owners should add the RACI to the Jira description using the template below; 3) we need a clear handoff checklist for when infra work is done so platform can validate.

aj: I can coordinate platform handoff. I'll create a short handoff ticket and tag platform-oncall. Tentative handoff date: 2026-04-02.

kate: Acceptance criteria I'm tracking (will paste into INF-4523):
```
- No eviction event > 5% for 1h in staging under linear load test
- Regression test added to CI (ttl_regression_suite)
- Alert created: eviction-rate > 3% triggers page
- Docs: runbook section updated
```

sanjay: FYI infra plan snippet: create eviction-rate limiter at proxy layer + circuit-breaker to avoid cascades. I'll add perf test & capacity safety margin. Will attach bench results to INF-4524.

jamie: Request: can we tag these tickets as part of the monthly "recurring-incident" epic so we get trend visibility? Otherwise new tickets get lost.

maria.s: Yes — tag with EPIC-REC-2026-Q1. Also @aj, please ensure the handoff ticket references the epic and the runbook ticket (INF-4525).

aj: Will do. I also propose a short 30m sync next Tuesday to formalize the RACI and acceptance criteria. Who can make it?

kate: I can. :thumbsup:

sanjay: I can too.

jamie: I'll join but please record notes.

maria.s: Summary / ask: owners (kate, sanjay, jamie) — confirm RACI and add due dates into the Jira tickets by EOD Friday. @aj will create the handoff ticket and tag platform-oncall. Ops-bot created INF-4525 for runbook updates. Once tickets are updated, I'll close the loop and schedule the sync. Reaction with :thumbsup: when done.

aj: ack — creating handoff ticket now.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: owners to update JIRA fields (RACI,due date,epic) in 48h.

maria.s: Thanks everyone — rough plan looks good. We'll track progress in the weekly remediation tracker and escalate if any due dates slip. :eyes:
